test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 26 Oct, 2023)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2 **i.e. **focus**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** context of the passage** is** discussing** the ongoing fight for social justice and equality, indicating that it is a central and significant issue.
 
• The word "**focus**" appropriately conveys the idea of attention and concentration on a significant global issue.
 
• "**Drift**," "**divergence**," and "**dispersion**" do not correctly express the idea of a primary concern or central issue.

Therefore, the **correct answer **is **focus**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1**: **drift**. This word implies a gradual or aimless movement or course, which does not fit the context of a significant global issue.
 
• **Option 3**: **divergence**. This word refers to a difference or variation, which does not align with the idea of a concentrated issue.
 
• **Option 4**: **dispersion**. This word suggests spreading or scattering, which does not describe the concentrated attention on social justice and equality.
